answer: UMBER-DEBT: a new identity pays an admission bond that grows in a spiral with how many that operator already holds - the kth puppet costs k times the base. The public umber ledger darkens per operator as bond mass climbs; past a threshold the fleet freezes into tundra, keeping attestations but losing countersign and vote rights until part of the bond is burned. A farm of a thousand puppets carries bond mass no operator will fund, and each frozen wave turns sunk cost into dead weight.
